how_it_behaves: A centered Django administration login form leads to a Site administration home page. After login a browser 'Save password?' popup may overlay the right side of the screen and must be dismissed before working. Orders are reached from the Orders link under the SHOP section, not from the ORD links in Recent actions. The Orders list has a search box that filters to matching rows with NUMBER, CUSTOMER, STATUS, TOTAL and TRACKING columns; clicking a blue order number opens a Change order form where Number and Tracking are text boxes and Status and Customer are dropdowns.

skills.name: read_order_details
skills.does: Read and verify the number, customer, status and tracking number from an open Change order form.

inputs.order_number: the expected order number, used to verify the open record

fields.number: the value in the text box to the right of the 'Number:' label near the top of the Change order form, below the bold order-number heading and not the breadcrumb at the top
fields.customer: the selected value in the dropdown to the right of the 'Customer:' label, below the Number field
fields.status: the selected value in the dropdown to the right of the 'Status:' label, below the Customer field and above the Total field
fields.tracking: the value in the text box to the right of the 'Tracking:' label, below the Total text box and above the Notes area

skills.name: read_order
skills.does: Log in, open a given order, and report its status and tracking number.

inputs.order_number: the order number to find, for example an ORD-prefixed code

steps.question: Is the Change order form still showing the order {order_number} with its Status dropdown and Tracking box visible?
steps.why: Read the result back on the final screen so a wrong-record or wrong-field report is caught.

goal: Log in with username {username} and password {password}. Open order ORD-10530 and report its status and tracking number.
